description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling sharded tensor operations, focusing on chunk sharding specifications, registering sharded operations, column-wise sharding of weights, normalization, gathering inputs, and masking input indices for distributed tensor computations within PyTorch's distributed sharding framework.

methods.name: _chunk_sharding_spec_check(spec, op)
methods.description: Checks if the given sharding spec is a ChunkShardingSpec before performing operations that require this specific sharding type.

methods.name: _register_sharded_op_on_local_tensor( op, early_stop_func=None, extra_check=None, customized_func=None )
methods.description: Registers a PyTorch operation to be executed on the local tensor of a sharded tensor, handling dispatch, customization, and proper function application based on the sharding spec.

methods.name: _handle_col_wise_sharding_base( op_func, col_dim, input, world_size, weight, local_shard, pg, gathered_inputs, mode=None, gathered_per_sample_weights=None, gathered_offsets=None, padding_idx=None, )
methods.description: Performs col-wise sharding operations, including gathering inputs, applying the operation, and redistributing results with proper column rearrangement.

methods.name: _result_distribute_with_col_rearrange(results, input, world_size, weight, pg)
methods.description: Distributes the concatenated results to each rank with possible column rearrangement based on sharding placements.

methods.name: _handle_max_norm_col_wise( max_norm, norm_type, local_shard, input, world_size, gathered_inputs, pg, )
methods.description: Performs max-norm normalization across all ranks for col-wise sharded weight tensors.

methods.name: _all_gather_base_input(input, pg)
methods.description: Gathers input tensors from all ranks using a base all_gather operation, concatenating them along the batch dimension.

methods.name: _handle_row_wise_mask(gather_inp, padding_idx, weight, world_size, rank)
methods.description: Masks input indices for embedding lookups based on shard placement and adjusts padding index accordingly for distributed embedding layers.

ctags.name: _handle_col_wise_sharding_base
ctags.signature: ( op_func, col_dim, input, world_size, weight, local_shard, pg, gathered_inputs, mode=None, gathered_per_sample_weights=None, gathered_offsets=None, padding_idx=None, )

ctags.name: _handle_max_norm_col_wise
ctags.signature: ( max_norm, norm_type, local_shard, input, world_size, gathered_inputs, pg, )
